jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
We are looking for an environmental expert to be a part of AB Tetra Paks Site Management team, reporting to AB Tetra Paks Environment manager.
AB Tetra Pak Site Management safeguards the licence to operate and creates the conditions for continued development of Tetra Pak’s Swedish businesses across all sites to operate safely, sustainably, efficiently and resiliently by providing local governance, compliance, infrastructure and cross-company coordination, as well as managing and coordinating relationships with relevant external authorities within these areas. 
You will be a part of a team dedicated to in realising the strategic ambitions of the Swedish sites within our Sustainability topics Climate, Circularity and Nature. Your role will have a focus on data management, digitalization, analyses och communication.
You will be based in Lund, Sweden but you will work in a global arena.

What you will do
As our new Environment Expert you will:
Drive projects and implement central initiatives in our Swedish business based on a data driven approach, to secure compliance to legal and internal requirements and to improve the Swedish sites environmental performance.
Collaborate with stakeholders, such as other environmental experts, our business and authorities.
Be one of the driving parts in developing of our Swedish Sustainability report. Contributing with texts and insights.
Coordinate our Swedish local sustainability data process related to areas such as climate, energy, water and waste, from collection and validation to analysis and internal and external reporting.
Develop smarter and more efficient ways of managing, structuring, automating and using Swedish sustainability data in our value chain. Proactively identify and drive continuous improvements in data management.
Transform complex data across systems and our value chain into clear insights, visualisations and compelling sustainability communication, as a support for decision-making in project and improvement initiatives.

We believe you have
You have a master’s degree in engineering with a relevant environmental specialisation, or an equivalent qualification.
You have professional experience in the environmental field.
You are fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken.
You have proven communications skills, written and spoken as well as a strategic mindset.
Have strong working knowledge of data analysis and programming tools, such as Power BI, Excel, Python etc.
Have strong working knowledge of visualisation and presenting, such as PowerPoint and Adobe InDesign.
Previous experiences of working within the Tetra Pak organisation are considered meritorious

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026-11-17
To know more about the position contact Ola Trulsson at +46 46 36 2029
Questions about your application contact Josephine Malalla at +46 46 36 5253
For trade union information contact Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533 and Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320

jobs.occupation: CEO for a pioneering technology company
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on creating business value, leading people and bringing pioneering technology to market? Would you like to spearhead a company developing innovative solutions for growing international markets?
Our client is looking for a CEO to lead its next phase, working closely with the engineers and scientists behind the company's technology. You will develop the business, bring the organisation together around clear priorities and build the international relationships that turn technical progress into commercial opportunities.
This is an opportunity to lead the commercialization of proprietary technology, combining the expertise of a highly qualified technical team with your own ability to build an international business.
Does this sound like the opportunity for you? Read on.

About the role
As CEO, you will lead and develop the company across its two business areas. You will shape the business strategy with the board and take responsibility for its execution within the agreed budget, translating it into priorities and shared goals.
You will act on and create business opportunities and personally drive key commercial relationships and negotiations. Working closely with the technical leadership, CFO/COO and board, you will unite customer needs, technical capabilities and financial priorities.
The role calls for commercial judgement and enough technical understanding to work confidently with customers, partners and specialists. You will draw on the expertise within the organisation while taking responsibility for decisions, direction and progress.
The company is based in Gothenburg, Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence with the team and international travel.

In this role you will

Develop and execute the commercial direction in alignment with the board, focusing on markets and opportunities with the strongest commercial potential.

Use and develop your international network to build relationships with industrial customers and partners.

Personally drive complex business opportunities from initial dialogue through negotiation to agreement.

Build internal structures, with clear responsibilities, decision-making and follow-up.

Lead the organisation towards shared goals, aligning technical development and resources with business priorities.

Prioritize resources towards the most attractive opportunities within the agreed budget, taking responsibility for cash flow and funding planning together with the CFO/COO and board.

Communicate progress, opportunities and risks clearly to employees, the board and investors.

Build relationships with investors and lead capital raising initiatives.

To succeed in this role you will bring

Experience leading and developing a technology-intensive business, business unit or commercial function, with responsibility for people, resources and financial results.

The ability to turn strategic goals into clear priorities, effective ways of working and measurable progress.

A hands-on approach with the ability to deliver results in a small organization with limited resources.

A proven record of personally developing and closing complex international B2B technology agreements with industrial customers.

A relevant international industry network and experience bringing new technology to market, including customer testing, qualification or development partnerships.

Solid technical understanding and commercial experience from technology-driven markets such as advanced electronics, materials, energy technology, industrial technology or related fields.

A relevant educational background in technology or business, or equivalent professional experience, excellent English and the ability to travel internationally.

Additional experience we value
Previous CEO responsibility, capital raising and experience in a listed company is valuable. Experience in industrial automation, telecommunications, sensor technology or advanced manufacturing may also be relevant where it includes comparable commercialisation and industrial business development.

Personal qualities
You are a clear and approachable leader who takes responsibility for the whole business. You listen to the expertise around you, make considered decisions and explain the priorities behind them. You enjoy creating opportunities and stay involved in the work needed to move them forward. When conditions change or the way ahead is uncertain, you maintain focus, adapt your approach and keep people informed. You build trust through realistic expectations and consistent follow-through.

Application and contact
Do you recognize yourself in this description? We would love to hear from you!
Please send us your application, we look forward to meeting you.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so do not wait to apply.

If you have questions about the role, please contact
Linus Pihlsgård, linus.pihlsgard@getskills.se
Or
Mimmi Nyman, mimmi.nyman@getskills.se

Are you eager to influence the future direction of Arla Foods? Do you envision yourself as a future leader?
How will you make an impact?
The Arla F15 Graduate Programme is a two-year, international development programme designed for graduates who want to learn quickly, explore different areas of a global business and grow into future leadership opportunities.
Through three eight-month rotations, you will work on meaningful business projects, build an international network and develop the confidence, skills and experience to make an impact at Arla. Business areas for projects may include Marketing, Sales, HR, Strategy, Sustainability, Business Development, and Supply Chain. We will match you with a suitable department based on business needs and your profile, offering you the chance to learn and make a difference. Your F15 Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027.

First rotation (8 months - Aarhus, Denmark) Based at one of our offices in Aarhus you will be assigned a strategically important project somewhere in the business.
Second rotation (8 months - Outside Denmark) You will have more influence over your second project assignment, which will give you the opportunity to continue growing in a meaningful way whilst adding real value to Arla.
Third rotation (8 months - Any Arla market) You will collaborate with the business to source potential high impact projects for your third rotation. You will have the most influence over projects during your final rotation.

 
What will make you a successful F15 Graduate?
To apply for the F15 Graduate Programme, please ensure that you meet the following criteria
You should either be in the process of completing, or have completed, a bachelor’s or master’s degree between September 2025 and September 2027. We welcome diverse educational backgrounds but seek candidates with a strong drive towards a business-focused career.
International experience gained from working, studying or volunteering abroad is an advantage.
Preferably at least one year of relevant work experience from student jobs or a minimum of six months of internship experience.
You are globally mobile and willing to go on one or two rotations abroad during the two-year programme. As your first rotation is based in Aarhus, Denmark you will need to relocate unless you already reside in the local area. Arla Foods will support you with this relocation.

 
This programme will suit graduates who have leadership aspirations and an ambitious mindset, which combines strategic thinking with a passion for results. A global mindset is essential, as is the ability to build positive relationships and strong influencing skills. The ideal candidate should be curious, competitive, and open to change, demonstrating resilience, while also being humble, self-aware, and open to feedback.
Throughout the rotations you will receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To ensure your professional and personal development, you will benefit from
Responsibilities from day one, enabling on-the-job learning in three different areas
Graduate development camps, taking place in different markets with your graduate colleagues
One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders
Be part of a supportive graduate community across all Arla Futures programmes 

Important information before applying
The application period for the F15 Graduate Programme runs from 2nd November 2026 until 2359 CET on 3rd January 2027. Before applying, please ensure you have prepared your CV and cover letter in English. You will be asked a series of questions on the application page, so we recommend that you start the application process from a computer instead of a mobile phone.
For additional information, read more about the F15 Graduate Programme on our website. Here, you can get inspiration from some of our previous and current F15s and learn more about the programme. You can also read more about what to expect from the recruitment process on our website.
Shape the Future of Dairy
Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Join our Backend Team in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
We’re looking for experienced Backend Developers in Gothenburg who combine strong technical skills with ownership, curiosity and a genuine drive to move things forward.
What you’ll be working with
You’ll join a development team at one of our clients, building and operating modern backend services and cloud-based platforms for connected products and digital services.
The exact technology stack will vary by assignment. It may include Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go, together with AWS and/or Azure. Some teams focus on customer-facing backend services, while others develop cloud platforms, integrations and developer tools.
You’ll work in a collaborative, DevOps-oriented environment and contribute throughout the service lifecycle, from design and development to deployment, monitoring, operations and continuous improvement.
Your work may include
Developing and maintaining backend services using Java, C#/.NET, Python and/or Go
Designing and building cloud-native solutions on AWS or Azure
Building REST APIs, microservices and integrations
Working with event-driven systems and distributed architectures
Using cloud services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and SQS
Working with containers and Kubernetes, depending on the team
Improving CI/CD, automation, monitoring, logging and service reliability
Contributing to code reviews, technical discussions and architecture decisions

Skills & qualifications
We’re looking for someone with:
At least 5 years of professional backend development experience
Strong experience in at least one of the following: Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure
Experience building and operating APIs, services or distributed systems
A good understanding of software quality, reliability and maintainability
Fluent written and spoken English
A BSc or MSc in Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good to have
AWS serverless experience, such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS
Experience with Azure services
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications
CI/CD and DevOps practices
Event-driven architecture or tools such as Kafka
Experience in connected services, IoT, automotive or telecom
Fluent written and spoken Swedish

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

Company description:
At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.
Job description:Deliver technical support in a global companyDo you enjoy resolving IT issues and helping users have a positive experience? As our Onsite Support Specialist in Karlskrona, you will deliver direct technical support for hardware, software, networks, and IT services while helping us maintain a stable, secure, and efficient IT environment.
 This is an opportunity to join NKT’s global IT organization and work in an international environment where collaboration, continuous improvement and high-quality support are key. You will be close to our users, handle technical challenges and contribute to developing smarter and more efficient ways of working.
 Would you like to combine your technical skills with service and problem-solving in a global organization?
 The first point of contact for IT-related questionsAs an Onsite Support Specialist, you will be the first point of contact for IT-related questions, incidents and service requests. You will investigate and resolve hardware and software issues, support users and manage cases through to resolution. You will also help maintain IT standards, contribute to documentation and knowledge articles, and identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement.
 Working closely with colleagues across Group IT, including IT Security, Infrastructure and Applications, you will contribute to stable IT operations and a positive end-user experience.
 Your key responsibilities will include:•    Handle incidents and service requests according to agreed SLAs•    Deploy, maintain and troubleshoot standard hardware and software•    Support IT equipment requests and coordinate hardware replacements•    Create and maintain knowledge articles and technical documentation•    Identify improvements and automation opportunities within IT support
 The position is based in Karlskrona, within Global IT Support and reports to the Manager Onsite Support. You will collaborate with Group IT colleagues, end users, stakeholders and external suppliers.
 Service-minded IT specialist who enjoys solving problemsYou are a solution-oriented and collaborative person who enjoys helping others and handling challenges when they arise. With a methodical approach, you are comfortable diagnosing and finding practical solutions. You communicate clearly with different users and stakeholders and know how to stay professional when priorities shift or situations become demanding.
 You enjoy working as part of a team but are equally comfortable taking responsibility for your own tasks. Curiosity and a motivation to learn help you adapt to new technologies, while your customer-focused mindset enables you to create a positive experience for end users.
 We are looking for someone with:•    Education in Computer Science or a relevant field•    2+ years of experience in service desk, onsite support, systems administration or a similar role•    Good knowledge of Windows desktop operating systems, Office 365 and basic computer hardware•    Experience handling IT incidents and service requests, with an understanding of ITIL processes•    Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken Grow your IT career in a global NKT team NKT is dedicated to building a diverse organization and a culture in which people from all backgrounds can thrive and perform at their best. We believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better place to work.
 At NKT, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical and problem-solving skills while working with colleagues and stakeholders across an international organization. You will be part of a collaborative IT environment where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and learning are encouraged, while contributing to reliable IT services that support NKT’s operations.
 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 17th of November 2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: R&D Team Lead.
Your role and responsibilities
At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration, combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities, are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.
Are you passionate about embedded technology and motivated by taking broad technical ownership of products throughout their lifecycle? Do you enjoy bridging technical details with system-level thinking while working closely with customers and stakeholders?
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to play a key role in the continued development and technical evolution of ABB's embedded product portfolio. In this position, you will combine your expertise in embedded electronics and software with a strong product mindset, ensuring products continue to meet customer needs, quality standards, and future business requirements.
You will work across multiple disciplines and collaborate closely with R&D teams, product management, manufacturing, suppliers, and customers. Success in this role requires a broad technical foundation, curiosity, and the ability to connect expertise from different domains to drive effective solutions and informed technical decisions.
Your main responsibilities
Take technical ownership of products throughout their lifecycle, from development and release to maintenance and continuous improvement.
Work across embedded electronics and software disciplines, understanding the interaction between hardware, firmware, software, and overall system functionality.
Translate customer and product requirements into technical specifications, priorities, and development activities.
Collaborate closely with developers, system architects, product managers, manufacturing teams, and other stakeholders to drive product success.
Lead investigations of complex technical product issues together with subject matter experts and development teams.
Support customers and internal stakeholders with technical guidance and product-related expertise.
Contribute to technical decisions, product enhancements, quality initiatives, and long-term product roadmaps.
Identify technical risks, opportunities for improvement, and relevant emerging technologies that can strengthen ABB's product offering.

Qualifications for the role
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Extensive experience in embedded product development, preferably 10 years or more.
Solid technical expertise in both embedded electronics and embedded software.
Broad understanding of electronics design, firmware/software development, interfaces, verification, and product lifecycle management.
Experience working with technically advanced products in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
Experience in technical product ownership, systems engineering, technical leadership, or similar cross-functional roles is highly valued.
Ability to navigate seamlessly between detailed technical challenges, system-level architecture discussions, and long-term product strategy.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and pragmatic approach.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and organizational boundaries.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

More about us
You will be part of Process Control Platform (PCP) which is a unit within ABB Business Area Process Automation. PCP develops automation products - hardware and software - for monitoring, process control and optimization. We have automation products for all kinds of industries all over the world

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer – Dog Transportation in Car
jobs.description:
Bring your life
Are you passionate about developing products where safety, engineering excellence, and user experience come together? Do you want to help create innovative solutions that allow people and their dogs to travel safely and comfortably together?
As part of our Dog Transportation category, you'll contribute to solutions that combine thoughtful design, engineering excellence, and industry-leading safety. With an exciting product portfolio and roadmap ahead, you'll help shape dog transportation solutions that make adventures with dogs safer, easier, and more enjoyable.
 
What you'll do at Thule
As a Mechanical Design Engineer - Dog Transportation in Car, you'll be part of our committed engineering team developing innovative dog transportation solutions for vehicles, including dog crates and related products. Together, we take ideas from concept to finished product through a structured and collaborative development process.
In this role, you will design and develop components in CAD, create high-quality technical specifications, and collaborate closely with project managers, simulation and test engineers, and prototype specialists to solve technical challenges and ensure every detail meets the high standards and requirements of the automotive industry.
You will take an active role in ordering and evaluating prototypes, analyzing test results, and using simulations to verify the strength and performance of your designs.
In addition, you will document technical solutions, manage design-related risks, and contribute to engineering best practices. Leading and supporting design reviews will be an important part of your role, helping ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability.
 
What you bring
To succeed in this role, we believe you have a university degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, combined with some years of experience in mechanical design and product development.
You have worked with a variety of materials and understand how to optimize designs for functionality, durability, and safety. Experience from consumer products, automotive products, or other safety-critical applications is highly valuable. You are fluent in both Swedish and English.
As the role includes practical elements, we believe you thrive in a hands-on product development environment. As a person, you are self-driven, structured, and solution-oriented, with the ability to turn ideas into robust and well-engineered products. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and can effectively manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
 
Why you should join Thule
At Thule, we are Proud to Be Thule. We believe anything is possible when we stay curious, take initiative and challenge ourselves. We encourage everyone to take ownership and make the most of their part of the business.
We believe we win as a team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting one another. United by our passion for our products, the outdoors and the Thule brand, we take pride in what we do and create a culture where everyone contributes, grows and has fun.
 
Hiring Process
Apply by submitting your application and resumé through “Apply for position” on our Thule Career Site. The application deadline is November 22, 2026.
Please make sure to not wait to show your interest until the last application date as interviews are held continuously during the process, and the position might be filled before the last application date. Please also note that we do not accept applications by e-mail.
If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Oscar Persson, at Oscar.persson@thule.com
We look forward to hearing from you!
Thule is a global sports and outdoor company. We offer high-quality products with smart features and a sustainable design that make it easy for people across the globe to live an active life. Under the motto Bring your life — and with a focus on consumer-driven innovation and long-term sustainability — we develop, manufacture and market products within the product categories Sport & Cargo Carriers (roof racks, roof boxes and carriers for transporting cycling, water and winter sports equipment, and rooftop tents mounted on a car), Active with Kids & Dogs (car seats, strollers, bike trailers, child bike seats and dog transport), RV Products (awnings, bike carriers and tents for RVs and caravans) and Bags & Mounts (backpacks, luggage and performance mounts).
Thule Group has about 3,000 employees at nine production facilities and 35 sales offices worldwide. The Group’s products are sold in 138 markets and in 2025, sales amounted to SEK 10,4 billion.
www.thulegroup.com

Company description:
"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity.
Job description:We are now looking for a Senior Legal Counsel IP to join our IP Legal Team in Volvo Group IP. 
 Who are we, your new colleagues?  
 Volvo Group IP handles intellectual property matters for the complete Volvo Group – which includes not only Volvo Trucks but also e.g. Volvo Buses, Volvo Penta, Volvo Construction Equipment and autonomous solutions – in a business-integrated, strategic setup with a proactive approach. Volvo Group IP is part of the Truck Technology & Industrial (TTI) division’s Legal & Volvo Group IP function, where we work close to technology and business to enable innovation and protect value.
 Volvo Group IP takes care of the complete life cycle of trademarks, designs and patents, supporting and advising in strategic partnerships, licensing and other complex IP related agreements, driving enforcement and defense matters and handling IP risk assessments. 
  What is our offer to you?  
 As Senior Legal Counsel – Intellectual Property (IP), you will play a key role in protecting and leveraging Volvo Group’s intellectual property while enabling innovation and supporting business priorities across the organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across Volvo’s global operations, providing strategic legal advice and practical solutions in complex IP matters. 
 Combining legal expertise with a strong business perspective, you will help navigate challenging situations, strengthen partnerships and develop the processes and ways of working needed to manage IP effectively in a changing technology landscape. 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
   
Innovation and technology: Support R&D and engineering teams on IP matters related to new technologies, product development and emerging areas such as electrification, software and connectivity. 
 
    
IP risk management: Assess and manages IP risks, including patent infringement, freedom-to-operate questions and potential disputes, working with internal experts and external legal partners as needed. 
 
    
Commercial agreements: Provide IP expertise in negotiations and contract drafting involving technology collaborations, licensing, joint development, complex supplier relations and other strategic partnerships where IP is at the core of the matter. 
 
    
Litigation and enforcement: Manage and support IP disputes, litigation and enforcement matters, working with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel to protect Volvo Group’s rights and interests across the globe. 
 
    
IP awareness and collaboration: Build strong relationships across the organization, helping colleagues understand IP implications and incorporate IP considerations into their everyday work. 
 
    
Continuous improvements: Identify opportunities to strengthen Volvo Group's IP processes, ways of working and ability to capture value from innovation. 
 
  
You will also act as an ambassador for IP both within Volvo Group, and to the wider community and you will protect the Volvo Group brand by supporting our global IP enforcement strategy, taking decisive action against counterfeits, and safeguarding customers, products, and our reputation. This role is located in Gothenburg, Sweden, where also the full IP Legal team and the leadership team is located.   
 Who are you? Are we a perfect match? 
 You bring hands-on IP expertise. You are a true collaborator—low prestige, high trust—who gets things done and helps your team when needed. You thrive in a fast-moving environment, embrace change and new challenges, and you spot what needs to happen next. You combine a can-do mindset with sound judgement, and you are proactive and autonomous, with a strong sense of ownership.  
 We also believe you have: 
   
Master of Laws or equivalent legal qualification. 
 
    
7+ years’ experience in IP (in-house and/or private practice), covering a broad mix of advisory, transactional and contentious matters. 
 
    
Established expertise across key IP areas (patents, trademarks and designs), including enforcement/defense, licensing/strategic agreements and IP risk management. 
 
    
Experience leading complex IP disputes or high-stakes negotiations in an international environment is considered a strong merit. 
 
    
Strong business acumen.   
 
    
Strong digital proficiency and a willingness to embrace new and more efficient ways of working.  
 
    
Experience from automotive/industrial technology is a plus. 
 
    
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
 
    
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to partner with engineering and senior leaders across a global organization.

The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Java Developer – Microservices, Serverless & AWS Cloud
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a skilled Java Developer for an exciting consulting opportunity within connected vehicle services and automotive software.
Are you curious about technology, passionate about clean and maintainable code, and enthusiastic about solving problems collaboratively? Do you enjoy pair programming, mob programming, and building cloud-native services that are reliable, scalable, and ready for production? This opportunity could be an excellent fit for you!
🔧 About the Role
You will join an open-minded and collaborative software engineering team working primarily with Java, microservices, and serverless architectures. The team values experimentation, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and thoughtful engineering decisions.
You will take responsibility for the services you help build, from understanding requirements and designing solutions to implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. The team follows agile practices and emphasises DevSecOps, continuous integration, and continuous delivery.
Stakeholder support and on-call responsibilities are shared across the team, offering an opportunity to contribute to both development and the reliable operation of production services.
🎯 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using Java.
Build and enhance applications based on microservices and serverless architectures.
Develop cloud-native solutions using AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and SQS.
Collaborate with colleagues through pair programming and mob programming.
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, with a focus on long-term quality.
Analyze existing code, understand technical problems, and identify appropriate solutions.
Design and implement automated tests to ensure reliability and prevent regressions.
Participate in agile ceremonies, planning, refinement, and continuous improvement activities.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and reliable production deployments.
Support the services developed by the team, including troubleshooting and shared on-call responsibilities.
Collaborate with stakeholders and other technical teams to deliver business value.
Share knowledge and contribute to a culture of collective ownership and engineering excellence.

✅ Required Skills & Experience
We are looking for a collaborative developer with strong Java fundamentals and an interest in modern cloud engineering.
Strong development skills in Java.
Understanding of microservices and serverless architectures.
Experience working with agile methodologies.
Knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS), preferably including:
AWS Lambda
API Gateway
DynamoDB
SQS
CloudFormation
Willingness to work collaboratively through pair programming and mob programming.
Ability to analyze problems, evaluate alternative solutions, and consider how code can be tested and maintained.
Strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing skills.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.

⭐ Nice to Have
Experience or knowledge in the following areas is an advantage:
Container-based architectures and technologies.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Spring Boot and the Java ecosystem.
DevOps practices and automated software delivery.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD).
DevSecOps principles and secure software development.
Production support, monitoring, and troubleshooting of cloud-based applications.

🤝 Team & Ways of Working
You will join a team that values openness, curiosity, and shared responsibility. The team adapts its way of working to the task, using pair or mob programming when appropriate.
The engineering culture focuses on:
Collaborative development: Solving problems together and sharing knowledge.
Quality-first engineering: Writing maintainable code and testing solutions thoroughly.
Cloud-native delivery: Building scalable services using modern cloud technologies.
DevSecOps: Taking responsibility for security, development, deployment, and operations.
Continuous delivery: Using automated pipelines to release changes reliably and efficiently.
Continuous improvement: Experimenting with technologies and improving engineering practices over time.

👤 Who Should Apply?
We are looking for a thoughtful and curious Java developer who wants to understand not only how to solve a problem, but also why a particular solution is appropriate and how to ensure it continues working reliably.
You enjoy experimenting with new technologies, collaborating closely with colleagues, and taking ownership of the software you build. You value feedback, shared learning, and solutions that deliver lasting results rather than just quick fixes.
📩 Interested in This Opportunity?
Please submit your updated CV highlighting your experience with Java, microservices, serverless architectures, AWS, agile development, and collaborative engineering practices. Include relevant experience with Spring Boot, CI/CD, DevOps, or Infrastructure as Code where applicable.
👉 Explore the opportunity and apply: https://www.hykmann.com/careers

Are you a hands-on research scientist with deep expertise in medical imaging and strong technical skills in programming, data analytics and AI?

Do you enjoy combining scientific research with practical technical development, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?

Collective Minds is looking for a Research Scientist to drive scientific and technical contributions in public and private research consortia. This is an opportunity to combine research, technology and project ownership in a growing international healthtech company.

About Collective Minds
Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.

About the role
As Research Scientist, you will combine scientific expertise in medical imaging with hands-on technical development and ownership of selected research consortia.
Collective Minds currently participates in more than 10 public and private research consortia spanning medical imaging, big data, analytics and AI modeling and validation. These collaborations bring together academic hospitals, research organizations and industry partners across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.

Acting as a data manager and platform provider, Collective Minds plays a central role in these collaborations. You will be responsible for our contributions in two to three consortia, with the opportunity to apply your scientific and technical expertise, work independently and contribute to impactful research.
Your main responsibilities:
Lead Collective Minds' contributions in selected research consortia, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
Develop and implement technical solutions, including scripts, data pipelines, analytical tools, dashboards and AI-based applications.
Make scientific and technical decisions across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation.
Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.
Manage project scope and stakeholder expectations, clearly defining deliverables and commitments.
Take ownership of work package delivery, reporting to consortium partners, coordinators and funders, and efficient project close-outs.
Collaborate with internal teams and external research partners, coordinating additional resources when needed.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a scientifically experienced and technically skilled professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with the ability to independently develop solutions and deliver complex research projects.
You are analytical, pragmatic and hands-on, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines and driving results in a fast-moving environment.

We believe you have:
A strong scientific background in life sciences, medicine, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research.
Strong hands-on technical skills in Python, SQL, DICOM and AI frameworks, with experience developing scripts, data tools and analytical solutions. Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Superset or Metabase is a plus.
Experience delivering work packages in research consortia or grant-funded projects, including grant execution, reporting and project close-outs.
A proven ability to independently manage research projects within agreed budgets, timelines and scope, and make informed scientific and technical decisions.
Experience coordinating work across academic, clinical and industry partners, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Willingness to travel internationally as required, typically approximately every two months.
Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.

Why join Collective Minds?
At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare.
You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done.
This is an opportunity to work with leading scientific and industry partners, contribute to innovative research collaborations and play an important role in the continued growth of an international healthtech company.
